`new-fleet-base` is the integration base for the in-progress slice-fleet generation-2 program (specs/slice-fleet-gen2 and specs/slice-fleet): the squash of the formerly stacked PRs #571, #573, #574, #581, #609, and #614. It is deployed only to dev canaries and must not be deployed or merged as-is; follow-up PRs stack on it and the whole program lands on `main` as one change.

For this project it carries the gen-2 phase-4 alerting work: `box_signals.py` (the shared `MNGR_BOX_SIGNAL` vocabulary emitted by the box collector and matched by the alert rules), `alert_provisioning.py` behind `observability provision-alerts` (one payload-free OpenObserve alert rule per signal over `box_logs`, a direct GitHub-issue webhook destination, an optional SMTP fallback), and the template / destination / v2-alert operations added to `openobserve_api.py`. The detailed history is in this directory's `mngr-slice-fleet-gen2-phase-4` entry.
`OpenObserveApiInterface.list_dashboard_summaries` is abstract again: the decorator was lost when the minds-v0.4.4 release was merged down the gen-2 branch stack, so the interface no longer forced implementations to provide it.
